ui.Ураховано лише тематичні категорії справ: Only subject categories are included; context mentions are excluded. A case with three themes creates three pairs. Lift is the observed number of shared cases divided by the expected number under independent theme assignments in the selected corpus or inventory. It is a descriptive measure, not evidence of a substantive or causal relationship. Lift mode shows pairs with at least max(3, ⌈N × 0.0015⌉) shared titles. A blank value indicates a missing denominator. High lift based on few cases requires cautious interpretation. The selected pair is retained when switching inventories, including inventories with no shared cases. The graph shows only pairs matching the current filter. Full tables: theme_links_by_description.csv and theme_link_cases.csv in the corresponding tables subdirectory.

ui.У таблиці наведено всі десятиліття; * по: The table includes all decades; * indicates fewer than 100 cases in a decade. Inventory columns show titles containing the term / total titles. Charts display decades with at least 100 cases in this scope; if none qualify, all dated decades are shown.
ui.Частка заголовків із лексичною формою, а: The measure is the proportion of titles containing a lexical form, rather than the proportion of documents within files or the prevalence of ideas in the population. Ukrainian and Russian forms are grouped under one label for each term; matches and case titles are provided in the accompanying CSV. ui.недатовані й записи з некоректними датам: undated records and records with invalid dates are excluded from time-series charts.
ui.Заголовки архівних описів — короткі опис: Archival inventory titles are brief descriptions of files, rather than full document texts. Words such as political, revolutionary and politically unreliable are markers of title wording; they do not establish the beliefs of the people mentioned. Ukrainian and Russian inventory titles do not justify reading the charts as changes in the language of record keeping. Frequency changes may reflect differences in inventory composition across decades.
ui.Це перевірка відібраних формул, а не авт: This is a search for selected expressions, rather than automatic identification of all ideological markers. Honorary citizen is treated as a distinct estate title; serf is matched as a phrase to avoid confusion with fortress administration.
